Make a sauce of onion, tomato, pepper and thyme in butter with stock; steam fish in the sauce covered 8 min.
Boil sliced okra in salted water 8 min; remove half the water.
Whisk soaked cornmeal into the okra; turn with a cou-cou stick 10 min, adding okra water, until smooth and leaving the pot; butter; shape in a greased bowl.

c: Marinate chicken in garlic, thyme and salt.
Caramelise sugar in oil to dark amber; add chicken and stir to coat brown; add onion, pepper, carrot.

Bring vinegar, water, sugar, pimento and salt to a boil.
Pour over thin strips of onion, carrot, peppers and sliced Scotch bonnet; rest 1 h minimum.
Spoon pickle and liquid over hot fish; serve with festival or bammy.

c: Cook to deep amber; pour into 10 ramekins.
Blend all; rest 10 min; skim foam; pour over caramel.
Bake in water bath 150 °C 50 min until just set; chill overnight; turn out.
Rub; bind; rest 30 min; roll 3 mm; cut 10 cm rounds; pinch edges into crimped walls; chill.
Cook coconut with sugar, water, ginger and spice 15 min until sticky; add butter and vanilla; cool.
Cut beef 5 cm; place with ribs, cassareep, sugar, aromatics, spices and water in a heavy pot.
Simmer covered 3 h until the meat is tender and the sauce dark, glossy and spoonable; remove cinnamon and chilli.
Best rested 24 h; serve with bread or rice.

Shred vegetables; pack with sliced chilli; cover with vinegar, lime, cloves, salt; rest 24 h.
Fry 3 cm plantain pieces 160 °C 4 min; smash; fry 180 °C until crisp; salt.
fe0b0207.st: Griot fried to order; pikliz 0–3 °C 2 weeks.

c: Rub fats into flour and spices; bind with iced water; rest 1 h.
Roll 3 mm; cut 20 × Ø 15 cm rounds.
Brown beef; add aromatics and spices; add stock; simmer 20 min; bind with crumbs; cool completely.
Fill 95 g; fold half-moon; crimp with a fork; egg-wash.

Divide 90 g; roll into ovals; brush with melted butter; fold in half (not sealed).
Prove 30 min; bake 190 °C 15 min; brush with butter.
Cut goat 4 cm on the bone; rub with curry, aromatics and salt; marinate overnight.
Burn the extra curry powder in hot oil 30 s; sear goat in batches.
Add water; braise covered 2 h 30 min; add potato cubes 30 min until they thicken the gravy.

Pick ham into the soup; remove the chilli; mash a third of the beans to thicken.
Knead stiff dough; roll pieces between palms into 6 cm spinners; simmer in soup 10 min.

Cover; cook low 20 min; rest 10 min; remove chilli and thyme; fork through.
